headline: Paraguay Central Bank Begins Ueno Bank Savers Repayments
summary: Paraguay's central bank announced the initiation of repayments to Ueno Bank savers starting at $1,700, concurrent with the resignation of the interior minister.
why: Central bank interventions and liquidity measures are critical for maintaining banking sector stability and depositor confidence in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Central bank depositor repayment action impacts domestic financial stability.
